info.syllabusName: Phân tích và trực quan hóa dữ liệu khách hàng (Customer Analytics and Visualization)
info.description:
Through out this course, students will be capability to make
a framework of creating data driven marketing strategies, tools, and techniques
to understand and leverage customer data to make better marketing choices
(according to segmentation, targeting, positioning, forecasting and the 4Ps).
Customer analytics is a procedure by which customer behavior data is broken
down and used to help making key business decisions via market segmentation and
predictive analytics. Customer data is collected from browsing history and
buying patterns sources. The huge amount of data will be used to sketch past
buying behavior, predict future ones and prescribe new ways to influence future
buying decisions made by customers. This course provides an overview of the
field of analytics so that you can make informed business decisions.

clos.loDetails: Understand the importance of linking marketing activities to customer metrics.

Communicate key ideas about customer analysis techniques and drive key business outcomes
